items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I wasn't in his company very often, but I met him and he was a very fine fellow, I thought.

ctx.x: I wasn't in his company very often, but I met him and he was a very fine fellow, I thought. Why I never, you know -- then I -- we were friendly, but I was going so much that I never ran into him too much, but I -- the last time I saw Lonnie he was in Nashville, Tennessee, I think he was a doorman there in a hotel or something --
